conditions.text_en: Above 400% of the poverty level: under the Means Test you may still get 79% if your total medical debt (from any provider) is at least your household's yearly gross income.

conditions.text_en: Only for residents of 13 Middle Tennessee counties: Cannon, Davidson, DeKalb, Hickman, Rutherford, Warren, White, Montgomery, Putnam, Sumner, Williamson, Wilson and Humphreys (or continuing care from another Ascension facility).

conditions.text_en: Asset test: a patient whose assets exceed 250% of their poverty-level amount may not be eligible.

conditions.text_en: The deadline counts from the FIRST discharge bill. You can apply after 240 days, but then help covers only the unpaid balance.

conditions.text_en: Uninsured patients must work with a financial counselor to apply for Medicaid or other public programs first.

conditions.text_en: Ascension may also decide eligibility by presumptive scoring, without a full application.
